title: Continuous Online Fault Detection for Mobile Robots via Adaptive Edge Models
summary: An online approach to fault detection for mobile robots, where lightweight models running on the robot keep adapting to new operating conditions over time.

title: Analyzing Shapley Additive Explanations to Understand Anomaly Detection Algorithm Behaviors and Their Complementarity
summary: Uses SHAP contributions to compare how different anomaly detection algorithms make their decisions, and to identify which detectors complement each other.

title: Problématiques de la détection d'anomalies pour la détection de fautes dans la robotique mobile
summary: An overview of the open challenges in applying anomaly detection to fault detection on mobile robots.

title: Timeciel: Contextual Interactive Ensemble Learning for Time Series Classification
summary: Timeciel, a contextual and interactive ensemble learning method for time series classification, built on a multi-agent approach.

title: Création d'un jeu de données pour la détection de fautes sur les robots autonomes de service
summary: Building a dataset of real faults recorded on autonomous service robots, to train and evaluate fault detection methods.

title: Caractérisation de la complémentarité des détecteurs d'anomalies par l'analyse des contributions SHAP
summary: French version of our work on characterising the complementarity of anomaly detectors through SHAP contributions.

title: Modèle ensembliste multi-agents pour la détection d'anomalies explicable : application à la robotique de service
summary: A multi-agent ensemble model for explainable anomaly detection, applied to service robotics.

title: Détection d'anomalies explicable pour la sûreté et la longue autonomie des robots autonomes de service
summary: How explainable anomaly detection can improve the safety and long-term autonomy of service robots.
